Interesting! So:
- `{name` -> `['{name']` - this part starts with `{` but isn't matched by PARSE_RE
- `{name}` -> `['', '{name}', '']` - correctly matched
- `hello {world` -> `['hello {world']` - the whole thing is one part, not matching
- `{{name}` -> `['', '{{', 'name}']` - `{{` is escaped brace, `name}` is plain text

The problem is that in `_generate_expression`, when we see a part like `{name` (which starts with `{`), we call `_handle_field(part)`. But `_handle_field` just strips the first and last character, so `{name` becomes `name`, which is then treated as a valid field name!
